dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, can I tell you something? I feel bad about what I said to Fah yesterday.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, kən aɪ ˈtɛl juː ˈsʌmθɪŋ? aɪ ˈfiːl ˈbæd əˈbaʊt ˈwʌt aɪ ˈsɛd tə ˈfɑː ˈjɛstərdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She showed me her drawings for her art class, and I said they looked like a child's drawings.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈʃoʊd miː hɜːr ˈdrɔːɪŋz fər hɜːr ˈɑːrt ˈklæs, ənd aɪ ˈsɛd ðeɪ ˈlʊkt ˈlaɪk ə ˈtʃaɪldz ˈdrɔːɪŋz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, Nam. That wasn't very kind.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈnɑːm. ðæt ˈwʌzənt ˈvɛri ˈkaɪnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I wish I hadn't said it. I was tired and stressed, but that's not an excuse.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪ ˈwɪʃ aɪ ˈhædənt ˈsɛd ɪt. aɪ wʌz ˈtaɪərd ənd ˈstrɛst, bʌt ðæts ˈnɑːt ən ɪkˈskjuːs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. She cried and went to her room. I'm so ashamed of myself.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ʃiː ˈkraɪd ənd ˈwɛnt tə hɜːr ˈruːm. aɪm soʊ əˈʃeɪmd əv maɪˈsɛlf.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We all say things we regret. Have you apologized?
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈɔːl ˈseɪ ˈθɪŋz wiː rɪˈɡrɛt. hæv juː əˈpɑːlədʒaɪzd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not yet. If only I could go back and stop myself!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. ˈɪf ˌoʊnli aɪ kʊd ˈɡoʊ ˈbæk ənd ˈstɑːp maɪˈsɛlf!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Call her tonight. Tell her you didn't mean it. She'll forgive you.
dialogue.reading: ˈkɔːl hɜːr təˈnaɪt. ˈtɛl hɜːr juː ˈdɪdənt ˈmiːn ɪt. ʃiːl fərˈɡɪv juː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope so. If only I had thought before I spoke!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ. ˈɪf ˌoʊnli aɪ hæd ˈθɔːt bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈspoʊk!
